units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|description|17|0
units.english: This Hai has asked you to smuggle him out of Unfettered space and bring him to <destination>.
units.italian: Questo Hai ti ha chiesto di farlo uscire di nascosto dallo spazio degli Unfettered e di portarlo su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|During the night, you hear a gentle scratching sound on your ship's main hatch. Do you investigate?|28|0
units.english: During the night, you hear a gentle scratching sound on your ship's main hatch. Do you investigate?
units.italian: Durante la notte senti un leggero rumore di graffi sul portello principale della tua nave. Vai a controllare?

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|	(Yes.)|30|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|	(No.)|31|0
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|	You grab a flashlight and open the hatch, and find a juvenile Hai there, with a large satchel slung over his shoulder. "You are the <first> <last>, yes?" he says. You nod. He says, "Is it true what is written here?"|33|0
units.english: You grab a flashlight and open the hatch, and find a juvenile Hai there, with a large satchel slung over his shoulder. "You are the <first> <last>, yes?" he says. You nod. He says, "Is it true what is written here?"
units.italian: Prendi una torcia e apri il portello, e trovi un giovane Hai con una grande sacca a tracolla. "Sei tu il <first> <last>, vero?", dice. Fai cenno di sì. Dice: "È vero quello che c'è scritto qui?"

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|	In his hands he is holding a piece of foil paper. You recognize it as the wrapper from one of the food rations that you have been transporting to the Unfettered, the "tribute" that they demand from the peaceful Hai. But having never unwrapped one of the rations, you had not realized that there is writing on the inside, a few words in the angular alphabet of the Hai. The Unfettered youth sees your look of confusion, and translates the message. "It says, 'Hai-home is your home too. Rejoin your people.'"|34|0
units.english: In his hands he is holding a piece of foil paper. You recognize it as the wrapper from one of the food rations that you have been transporting to the Unfettered, the "tribute" that they demand from the peaceful Hai. But having never unwrapped one of the rations, you had not realized that there is writing on the inside, a few words in the angular alphabet of the Hai. The Unfettered youth sees your look of confusion, and translates the message. "It says, 'Hai-home is your home too. Rejoin your people.'"
units.italian: Nelle mani tiene un pezzo di carta stagnola. Riconosci l'involucro di una delle razioni alimentari che hai trasportato agli Unfettered, il "tributo" che pretendono dagli Hai pacifici. Ma non avendo mai aperto una di quelle razioni, non avevi notato che all'interno c'è una scritta, poche parole nell'alfabeto spigoloso degli Hai. Il giovane Unfettered vede il tuo sguardo confuso e traduce il messaggio. "Dice: 'Hai-home è casa tua. Torna al tuo popolo.'"

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|	"I think it is true. The Hai who gave this tribute said they hoped the Unfettered would turn from violence and be reconciled with them."|36|0
units.english: "I think it is true. The Hai who gave this tribute said they hoped the Unfettered would turn from violence and be reconciled with them."
units.italian: "Credo che sia vero. Gli Hai che hanno dato questo tributo hanno detto che speravano che gli Unfettered rinunciassero alla violenza e si riconciliassero con loro."

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|	"I'm sorry, but I don't think they will ever let you live among them, if it is your nature to be prone to violence."|38|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I don't think they will ever let you live among them, if it is your nature to be prone to violence."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non credo che ti lasceranno mai vivere tra loro, se è nella tua natura essere incline alla violenza."

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|	You have little experience reading Hai emotions, but the youth seems crestfallen. "You are certain?" he asks.|39|0
units.english: You have little experience reading Hai emotions, but the youth seems crestfallen. "You are certain?" he asks.
units.italian: Hai poca esperienza nel leggere le emozioni degli Hai, ma il giovane sembra abbattuto. "Ne sei certo?", chiede.

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|	"I am certain. I can do nothing for you."|41|0
units.english: "I am certain. I can do nothing for you."
units.italian: "Ne sono certo. Non posso fare nulla per te."

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|	"Perhaps you can come with me and find out, but don't get your hopes up."|43|0
units.english: "Perhaps you can come with me and find out, but don't get your hopes up."
units.italian: "Forse puoi venire con me e scoprirlo, ma non farti troppe illusioni."

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|	"Will you take me to Hai-home?" he asks. "You are able to be outside Unfettered places. Can I go with you?"|46|0
units.english: "Will you take me to Hai-home?" he asks. "You are able to be outside Unfettered places. Can I go with you?"
units.italian: "Mi porterai su Hai-home?", chiede. "Tu puoi stare fuori dai luoghi degli Unfettered. Posso venire con te?"

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|	"Yes, I will take you there."|48|0
units.english: "Yes, I will take you there."
units.italian: "Sì, ti ci porto."

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|	"Sorry, I can't risk angering the Unfettered by carrying a defector."|50|0
units.english: "Sorry, I can't risk angering the Unfettered by carrying a defector."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non posso rischiare di far arrabbiare gli Unfettered trasportando un disertore."

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|	Disappointed, the youth leaves. You hope you made the right choice.|52|0
units.english: Disappointed, the youth leaves. You hope you made the right choice.
units.italian: Deluso, il giovane se ne va. Speri di aver fatto la scelta giusta.

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|	You show the youth to one of your bunk rooms, and tell him to stay hidden there until you reach Hai-home.|55|0
units.english: You show the youth to one of your bunk rooms, and tell him to stay hidden there until you reach Hai-home.
units.italian: Accompagni il giovane in una delle tue cabine e gli dici di restare nascosto finché non raggiungi Hai-home.

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|dialog|59|0
units.english: You look for the young Hai, but realize that he took a ride on one of your escorts! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Cerchi il giovane Hai, ma ti accorgi che è salito su una delle tue scorte! Meglio partire e aspettare che le tue scorte arrivino in questo sistema stellare.

units.id: mission:Unfettered returning home|You need not have worried about the reception the Unfettered youth would receive here on Hai-home. Scarcely minutes after you hesitantly contact the Hai government, a happy crowd has gathered around your ship. When he steps out of the hatchway, he looks stunned at being welcomed so warmly. One of the Hai governors thanks you for transporting him, and pays you <payment>.|63|0
units.english: You need not have worried about the reception the Unfettered youth would receive here on Hai-home. Scarcely minutes after you hesitantly contact the Hai government, a happy crowd has gathered around your ship. When he steps out of the hatchway, he looks stunned at being welcomed so warmly. One of the Hai governors thanks you for transporting him, and pays you <payment>.
units.italian: Non dovevi preoccuparti dell'accoglienza che il giovane Unfettered avrebbe ricevuto qui su Hai-home. Pochi minuti dopo che hai contattato con esitazione il governo degli Hai, una folla felice si è radunata attorno alla tua nave. Quando esce dal portello, sembra sbalordito di essere accolto con tanto calore. Uno dei governatori degli Hai ti ringrazia per averlo trasportato e ti paga <payment>.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|You recall a hooded figure offering a business opportunity in this shipyard. Do you want to follow their directions, and head to the specified coordinates?|88|0
units.english: You recall a hooded figure offering a business opportunity in this shipyard. Do you want to follow their directions, and head to the specified coordinates?
units.italian: Ricordi una figura incappucciata che ti ha offerto un'opportunità d'affari in questo cantiere. Vuoi seguire le sue indicazioni e dirigerti verso le coordinate indicate?

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	(Sure.)|90|0
units.english: (Sure.)
units.italian: (Certo.)

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	(Maybe another time.)|92|0
units.english: (Maybe another time.)
units.italian: (Forse un'altra volta.)

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	(Never.)|94|0
units.english: (Never.)
units.italian: (Mai.)

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|As you're browsing the shipyard, you are discreetly approached by a hooded figure. When you stop to see what they want to say, they grab and pull on your arm to follow them. "Keep walking," the stranger hisses. After pointing at and commenting on random ships, as if to mimic the actions of a regular passerby, they address you again.|97|0
units.english: As you're browsing the shipyard, you are discreetly approached by a hooded figure. When you stop to see what they want to say, they grab and pull on your arm to follow them. "Keep walking," the stranger hisses. After pointing at and commenting on random ships, as if to mimic the actions of a regular passerby, they address you again.
units.italian: Mentre giri per il cantiere, vieni avvicinato con discrezione da una figura incappucciata. Quando ti fermi per sentire cosa ha da dire, ti afferra il braccio e tira per farti seguire. "Continua a camminare", sibila lo sconosciuto. Dopo aver indicato e commentato navi a caso, come per imitare i gesti di un normale passante, ti si rivolge di nuovo.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"My associates and I have a lucrative business proposition for you. It will require your undivided attention, so you would do well to finish any ongoing business first. If you are interested, come find us at these coordinates."|98|0
units.english: "My associates and I have a lucrative business proposition for you. It will require your undivided attention, so you would do well to finish any ongoing business first. If you are interested, come find us at these coordinates."
units.italian: "I miei associati e io abbiamo una lucrosa proposta d'affari per te. Richiederà tutta la tua attenzione, quindi faresti bene a chiudere prima gli affari in corso. Se sei interessato, vieni a trovarci a queste coordinate."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	Just before leaving they add, "We note you operate multiple ships. However, this is a solitary affair; make sure you can park most of your ships."|99|0
units.english: Just before leaving they add, "We note you operate multiple ships. However, this is a solitary affair; make sure you can park most of your ships."
units.italian: Proprio prima di andarsene aggiungono: "Notiamo che gestisci più navi. Tuttavia, questa è una faccenda solitaria; assicurati di poter parcheggiare quasi tutte le tue navi."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	Without waiting for a response, they fold a piece of paper into your hand before quickly fading into the crowd. It lists only a location, and if you cross-reference it with the local maps, it appears to point towards a beach on the other side of the planet.|102|0
units.english: Without waiting for a response, they fold a piece of paper into your hand before quickly fading into the crowd. It lists only a location, and if you cross-reference it with the local maps, it appears to point towards a beach on the other side of the planet.
units.italian: Senza aspettare una risposta, ti piegano un pezzo di carta in mano e svaniscono in fretta tra la folla. C'è scritto solo un luogo, e se lo confronti con le mappe locali sembra indicare una spiaggia dall'altra parte del pianeta.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	However, the paper also mentions you need to have at least ten million credits in cash! You'll have to save up or take a loan and then come back another day before heading to the specified location.|105|0
units.english: However, the paper also mentions you need to have at least ten million credits in cash! You'll have to save up or take a loan and then come back another day before heading to the specified location.
units.italian: Però la carta dice anche che devi avere almeno dieci milioni di crediti in contanti! Dovrai metterli da parte o chiedere un prestito e tornare un altro giorno, prima di dirigerti verso il luogo indicato.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	Will you go there?|108|0
units.english: Will you go there?
units.italian: Ci andrai?

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	(Sure.)|110|0
units.english: (Sure.)
units.italian: (Certo.)

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	(Maybe another time.)|111|0
units.english: (Maybe another time.)
units.italian: (Forse un'altra volta.)

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	While you're pondering whether or not there will be enough space to land your ship at the beach, you notice a train ticket attached to the back of the paper. A few more written notes give specific directions on how to get there, with a clear demand not to take your starship at the bottom.|114|0
units.english: While you're pondering whether or not there will be enough space to land your ship at the beach, you notice a train ticket attached to the back of the paper. A few more written notes give specific directions on how to get there, with a clear demand not to take your starship at the bottom.
units.italian: Mentre ti chiedi se ci sarà abbastanza spazio per far atterrare la nave sulla spiaggia, noti un biglietto del treno attaccato sul retro della carta. Altri appunti scritti danno indicazioni precise su come arrivarci, con in fondo la chiara richiesta di non portare la nave stellare.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	To your surprise, the local train station is located underground. You can't begin to make sense of the enormity of it - it almost feels like you can reach the entire planet from here. You ask a Hai for directions, feeling embarrassed when you learn that all you had to do was scan your ticket at a nearby terminal and all relevant information would be displayed for you.|115|0
units.english: To your surprise, the local train station is located underground. You can't begin to make sense of the enormity of it - it almost feels like you can reach the entire planet from here. You ask a Hai for directions, feeling embarrassed when you learn that all you had to do was scan your ticket at a nearby terminal and all relevant information would be displayed for you.
units.italian: Con tua sorpresa, la stazione ferroviaria locale è sotterranea. Non riesci a capacitarti della sua enormità: sembra quasi che da qui si possa raggiungere l'intero pianeta. Chiedi indicazioni a un Hai, imbarazzato quando scopri che bastava scansionare il biglietto a un terminale vicino e tutte le informazioni utili sarebbero comparse.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	After departing the train station, you hike for a few hours until you reach your destination. Upon arriving, you look around for the stranger. Besides a cave, some sparse vegetation, and of course the beach itself, you cannot see anything significant in the vicinity. You double-check that these are the right coordinates and look around some more.|116|0
units.english: After departing the train station, you hike for a few hours until you reach your destination. Upon arriving, you look around for the stranger. Besides a cave, some sparse vegetation, and of course the beach itself, you cannot see anything significant in the vicinity. You double-check that these are the right coordinates and look around some more.
units.italian: Dopo essere uscito dalla stazione, cammini per qualche ora finché non raggiungi la destinazione. All'arrivo ti guardi attorno in cerca dello sconosciuto. A parte una grotta, una vegetazione rada e, naturalmente, la spiaggia stessa, non vedi nulla di significativo nei dintorni. Ricontrolli che le coordinate siano giuste e ti guardi ancora attorno.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	You wait for some time until you spot two hooded figures further down the beach, and you start to doubt whether or not this was a good idea as they make their way toward you. Even when they're close enough to speak, their faces somehow remain impossible to glimpse beneath the hoods. "Hello, <last>," one says to you. "We are sorry for the secrecy, but the truth is, we cannot afford to take risks. It is best for all if you do not know who we are, and we needed a secluded area to speak to you."|117|0
units.english: You wait for some time until you spot two hooded figures further down the beach, and you start to doubt whether or not this was a good idea as they make their way toward you. Even when they're close enough to speak, their faces somehow remain impossible to glimpse beneath the hoods. "Hello, <last>," one says to you. "We are sorry for the secrecy, but the truth is, we cannot afford to take risks. It is best for all if you do not know who we are, and we needed a secluded area to speak to you."
units.italian: Aspetti un po' finché non scorgi due figure incappucciate più avanti lungo la spiaggia, e cominci a dubitare che sia stata una buona idea mentre si avvicinano. Anche quando sono abbastanza vicini per parlare, i loro volti restano in qualche modo impossibili da scorgere sotto i cappucci. "Salve, <last>", dice uno. "Ci dispiace per la segretezza, ma la verità è che non possiamo permetterci rischi. È meglio per tutti se non sai chi siamo, e avevamo bisogno di un luogo isolato per parlarti."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"Tell me more."|119|0
units.english: "Tell me more."
units.italian: "Dimmi di più."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"How do you know me?"|121|0
units.english: "How do you know me?"
units.italian: "Come mi conosci?"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	(Run away.)|123|0
units.english: (Run away.)
units.italian: (Scappa.)

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	They seem surprised at your sudden change of mind, but make no effort to stop you.|124|0
units.english: They seem surprised at your sudden change of mind, but make no effort to stop you.
units.italian: Sembrano sorpresi dal tuo improvviso cambio di idea, ma non fanno nulla per fermarti.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|label|125|0
units.english: train back
units.italian: train back

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	Without any incidents, you return to the train station and buy a ticket back to the spaceport.|126|0
units.english: Without any incidents, you return to the train station and buy a ticket back to the spaceport.
units.italian: Senza incidenti, torni alla stazione e compri un biglietto per lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	The second one grins. "Any outsider landing on our homeworld must be well-known. We know you have helped our kind."|129|0
units.english: The second one grins. "Any outsider landing on our homeworld must be well-known. We know you have helped our kind."
units.italian: Il secondo sorride. "Qualsiasi esterno che atterri sul nostro mondo natale deve essere ben noto. Sappiamo che hai aiutato la nostra gente."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"Though do not think we are unaware of your skirmishes with the Unfettered," the first adds with a serious tone.|130|0
units.english: "Though do not think we are unaware of your skirmishes with the Unfettered," the first adds with a serious tone.
units.italian: "Però non pensare che non siamo al corrente dei tuoi scontri con gli Unfettered", aggiunge il primo con tono serio.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|label|133|0
units.english: tell me
units.italian: tell me

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	Suddenly, you hear a loud roar coming from the sea behind you, and the ground begins to shake.|134|0
units.english: Suddenly, you hear a loud roar coming from the sea behind you, and the ground begins to shake.
units.italian: All'improvviso senti un forte ruggito venire dal mare alle tue spalle, e il terreno comincia a tremare.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	(Turn around.)|136|0
units.english: (Turn around.)
units.italian: (Voltati.)

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	The waves become agitated and wind rushes past you as a shape surrounded by fumes emerges out of the water, as if an ancient sea monster was rising from the depths.|137|0
units.english: The waves become agitated and wind rushes past you as a shape surrounded by fumes emerges out of the water, as if an ancient sea monster was rising from the depths.
units.italian: Le onde si agitano e il vento ti passa accanto mentre una forma circondata da vapori emerge dall'acqua, come se un antico mostro marino risalisse dagli abissi.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	But it is no monster. It is a ship, and its weapons are aimed straight at you!|138|0
units.english: But it is no monster. It is a ship, and its weapons are aimed straight at you!
units.italian: Ma non è un mostro. È una nave, e le sue armi sono puntate dritte su di te!

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|label|139|0
units.english: try again
units.italian: try again

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	(Run!)|142|0
units.english: (Run!)
units.italian: (Corri!)

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	(Wait.)|143|0
units.english: (Wait.)
units.italian: (Aspetta.)

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	(Try to contact my fleet for help.)|145|0
units.english: (Try to contact my fleet for help.)
units.italian: (Prova a contattare la mia flotta per chiedere aiuto.)

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	(Shoot it!)|148|0
units.english: (Shoot it!)
units.italian: (Sparagli!)

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	As you try to react, the Hai closest to you firmly grabs your arm and shouts through the noise. "If this ship wanted to kill you, <last>, you would already be dead."|150|0
units.english: As you try to react, the Hai closest to you firmly grabs your arm and shouts through the noise. "If this ship wanted to kill you, <last>, you would already be dead."
units.italian: Mentre cerchi di reagire, l'Hai più vicino ti afferra saldamente il braccio e grida sopra il rumore. "Se questa nave avesse voluto ucciderti, <last>, saresti già morto."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	You can barely hear anything over the sound of the engines as the ship proceeds to land on the beach. Suddenly, all is calm. They turn to you, one more at ease than the other. "This ship means you no harm."|152|0
units.english: You can barely hear anything over the sound of the engines as the ship proceeds to land on the beach. Suddenly, all is calm. They turn to you, one more at ease than the other. "This ship means you no harm."
units.italian: Riesci a malapena a sentire qualcosa sopra il rumore dei motori, mentre la nave si posa sulla spiaggia. All'improvviso tutto è calmo. Si voltano verso di te, uno più a suo agio dell'altro. "Questa nave non ti vuole alcun male."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	(Say nothing.)|154|0
units.english: (Say nothing.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla.)

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"Why didn't you say anything before that happened?"|156|0
units.english: "Why didn't you say anything before that happened?"
units.italian: "Perché non hai detto nulla prima che succedesse?"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	The second one replies, "We could have, but where's the fun in that? We wanted to see how you would react.|157|0
units.english: The second one replies, "We could have, but where's the fun in that? We wanted to see how you would react.
units.italian: Il secondo risponde: "Avremmo potuto, ma dov'è il divertimento? Volevamo vedere come avresti reagito.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"This ship is our guarantee that nothing goes wrong, should you attempt something against us. After all, we are still not sure if we can trust you."|159|0
units.english: "This ship is our guarantee that nothing goes wrong, should you attempt something against us. After all, we are still not sure if we can trust you."
units.italian: "Questa nave è la nostra garanzia che nulla vada storto, se tentassi qualcosa contro di noi. Dopo tutto, non siamo ancora sicuri di poterti dare fiducia."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	The two Hai then take you to a nearby cave. Crystals embedded in the walls cast a faint blue glow as you follow them, until you approach a large chamber where sunlight breaks through cracks, revealing another ship. The first Hai then speaks again. "That ship outside is not for sale. This one, however, is a mighty relic of the past, intended for war from the times our empire used to control the stars - an Anomalocaris!"|160|0
units.english: The two Hai then take you to a nearby cave. Crystals embedded in the walls cast a faint blue glow as you follow them, until you approach a large chamber where sunlight breaks through cracks, revealing another ship. The first Hai then speaks again. "That ship outside is not for sale. This one, however, is a mighty relic of the past, intended for war from the times our empire used to control the stars - an Anomalocaris!"
units.italian: I due Hai ti portano poi in una grotta vicina. Cristalli incastonati nelle pareti diffondono un debole bagliore blu mentre li segui, finché non arrivi a una grande camera dove la luce del sole entra da fessure, rivelando un'altra nave. Il primo Hai parla di nuovo. "Quella nave fuori non è in vendita. Questa, però, è un possente relitto del passato, pensata per la guerra dai tempi in cui il nostro impero controllava le stelle: un Anomalocaris!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"What is this about?"|163|0
units.english: "What is this about?"
units.italian: "Di cosa si tratta?"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	The second one now takes a step toward you to speak, almost interrupting the first. "We have a proposition for you. Should you agree to bring much needed supplies to our brethren, the Unfettered Hai, we will sell you this ship for the modest price of ten million credits - including two weapons belonging to the savage Korath!" The first one seems surprised by this and tries to intervene, but the second resumes before they can speak up.|164|0
units.english: The second one now takes a step toward you to speak, almost interrupting the first. "We have a proposition for you. Should you agree to bring much needed supplies to our brethren, the Unfettered Hai, we will sell you this ship for the modest price of ten million credits - including two weapons belonging to the savage Korath!" The first one seems surprised by this and tries to intervene, but the second resumes before they can speak up.
units.italian: Il secondo ora fa un passo verso di te per parlare, quasi interrompendo il primo. "Abbiamo una proposta per te. Se accetti di portare rifornimenti di cui abbiamo molto bisogno ai nostri fratelli, gli Hai Unfettered, ti venderemo questa nave al modico prezzo di dieci milioni di crediti, comprese due armi appartenenti ai selvaggi Korath!" Il primo sembra sorpreso e cerca di intervenire, ma il secondo riprende prima che possano parlare.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"These weapons pack more of a punch than anything in human or even Hai space for their size! Worry not, you'll be able to recuperate the cost of this ship with ease by assisting us. A load of medical supplies is needed on <destination>, and we lack the time and personnel to bring them ourselves on such short notice.|165|0
units.english: "These weapons pack more of a punch than anything in human or even Hai space for their size! Worry not, you'll be able to recuperate the cost of this ship with ease by assisting us. A load of medical supplies is needed on <destination>, and we lack the time and personnel to bring them ourselves on such short notice.
units.italian: "Queste armi, per le loro dimensioni, colpiscono più forte di qualsiasi cosa nello spazio umano o persino degli Hai! Non preoccuparti, riuscirai a recuperare il costo di questa nave con facilità aiutandoci. Serve un carico di forniture mediche su <destination>, e ci mancano il tempo e il personale per portarle noi stessi con così poco preavviso.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"Of course, the ship is aged, and you should not expect the best price in a shipyard. Nevertheless, it is a fine vessel, capable of fighting, freighting, and mining. So, what do you say, <last>? This is the opportunity of a lifetime; they simply don't make ships like this anymore."|166|0
units.english: "Of course, the ship is aged, and you should not expect the best price in a shipyard. Nevertheless, it is a fine vessel, capable of fighting, freighting, and mining. So, what do you say, <last>? This is the opportunity of a lifetime; they simply don't make ships like this anymore."
units.italian: "Certo, la nave è vecchia, e non dovresti aspettarti il miglior prezzo in un cantiere. Tuttavia è un vascello pregevole, capace di combattere, trasportare merci ed estrarre minerali. Allora, cosa dici, <last>? È l'occasione della vita; navi come questa non le fanno più."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"I will help you."|169|0
units.english: "I will help you."
units.italian: "Vi aiuterò."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"If you lack crew, who was piloting the other ship?"|171|0
units.english: "If you lack crew, who was piloting the other ship?"
units.italian: "Se siete a corto di equipaggio, chi pilotava l'altra nave?"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"Why was the other ship hidden underwater?"|175|0
units.english: "Why was the other ship hidden underwater?"
units.italian: "Perché l'altra nave era nascosta sott'acqua?"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"No, thanks. I'm not looking to add another ship to my fleet."|179|0
units.english: "No, thanks. I'm not looking to add another ship to my fleet."
units.italian: "No, grazie. Non ho intenzione di aggiungere un'altra nave alla mia flotta."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	The two Hai look disappointed. "A shame. We will probably not meet again," one says. "It is best you forget we have met here," says the other. They signal the ship from earlier to submerge into the ocean again and walk off along the beach.|180|0
units.english: The two Hai look disappointed. "A shame. We will probably not meet again," one says. "It is best you forget we have met here," says the other. They signal the ship from earlier to submerge into the ocean again and walk off along the beach.
units.italian: I due Hai sembrano delusi. "Peccato. Probabilmente non ci incontreremo più", dice uno. "È meglio che tu dimentichi di averci incontrato qui", dice l'altro. Fanno cenno alla nave di prima di tornare sott'acqua e si allontanano lungo la spiaggia.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"The less you know, the better for all of us, Captain."|185|0
units.english: "The less you know, the better for all of us, Captain."
units.italian: "Meno sai, meglio è per tutti noi, capitano."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"We found it there," the first one answers.|190|0
units.english: "We found it there," the first one answers.
units.italian: "L'abbiamo trovata lì", risponde il primo.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"It is hard to find a drop of rain in a storm, but the drop of rain may see all as it falls," the other one adds.|191|0
units.english: "It is hard to find a drop of rain in a storm, but the drop of rain may see all as it falls," the other one adds.
units.italian: "È difficile trovare una goccia di pioggia in una tempesta, ma la goccia può vedere tutto mentre cade", aggiunge l'altro.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	They give you access to the ship and proceed to explain the details. "It is of no real significance, but surely you understand we cannot go through standard means for this sale. We will instead present it as a loan."|198|0
units.english: They give you access to the ship and proceed to explain the details. "It is of no real significance, but surely you understand we cannot go through standard means for this sale. We will instead present it as a loan."
units.italian: Ti danno accesso alla nave e passano a spiegare i dettagli. "Non ha una vera importanza, ma certo capisci che non possiamo fare questa vendita per i canali normali. La presenteremo invece come un prestito."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	You quickly realize that they are not asking you for your opinion at all. In fact, you receive notice of the debt before they have even finished speaking. "We will need to make some modifications to the ship before you can use it.|199|0
units.english: You quickly realize that they are not asking you for your opinion at all. In fact, you receive notice of the debt before they have even finished speaking. "We will need to make some modifications to the ship before you can use it.
units.italian: Capisci in fretta che non ti stanno affatto chiedendo un parere. Anzi, ricevi la notifica del debito prima ancora che abbiano finito di parlare. "Dovremo fare alcune modifiche alla nave prima che tu possa usarla.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	(Go back to the shipyard.)|201|0
units.english: (Go back to the shipyard.)
units.italian: (Torna al cantiere.)

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"Why would they mind a different ship?"|203|0
units.english: "Why would they mind a different ship?"
units.italian: "Perché dovrebbe importare loro una nave diversa?"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"As this ship is ancient, the Unfettered will try to preserve it. The same might not be true for other ships."|204|0
units.english: "As this ship is ancient, the Unfettered will try to preserve it. The same might not be true for other ships."
units.italian: "Dato che questa nave è antica, gli Unfettered cercheranno di preservarla. Lo stesso potrebbe non valere per altre navi."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	They walk away until you cannot hear them speak anymore, leaving you with the access codes to the ship so you can bring it to the shipyard. With the aid of the autopilot, you manage to pilot the ship without any complications.|206|0
units.english: They walk away until you cannot hear them speak anymore, leaving you with the access codes to the ship so you can bring it to the shipyard. With the aid of the autopilot, you manage to pilot the ship without any complications.
units.italian: Si allontanano finché non riesci più a sentirli, lasciandoti i codici di accesso della nave perché tu possa portarla al cantiere. Con l'aiuto del pilota automatico riesci a pilotarla senza complicazioni.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	You get your weapon out and proceed to shoot at the ship.|209|0
units.english: You get your weapon out and proceed to shoot at the ship.
units.italian: Estrai l'arma e cominci a sparare alla nave.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	Your shot reaches the ship, but the small weapon has no chance of doing anything to the heavy armor, even if it is somewhat worn. The ship then shoots back at you, barely missing and causing a geyser of sand to erupt at you, forcing you to drop your weapon. One of the two Hai then approaches you, seemingly disappointed.|214|0
units.english: Your shot reaches the ship, but the small weapon has no chance of doing anything to the heavy armor, even if it is somewhat worn. The ship then shoots back at you, barely missing and causing a geyser of sand to erupt at you, forcing you to drop your weapon. One of the two Hai then approaches you, seemingly disappointed.
units.italian: Il tuo colpo raggiunge la nave, ma la piccola arma non ha alcuna possibilità contro un'armatura pesante, anche se un po' consumata. Allora la nave risponde al fuoco, mancandoti di poco e facendo eruttare un geyser di sabbia che ti costringe a lasciar cadere l'arma. Uno dei due Hai ti si avvicina, apparentemente deluso.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	"You're lucky to still be alive, but even so you are of no use to us if you think it wise to use your firearm on a spaceship. Farewell." They turn and leave without another word, and the ship flies off.|215|0
units.english: "You're lucky to still be alive, but even so you are of no use to us if you think it wise to use your firearm on a spaceship. Farewell." They turn and leave without another word, and the ship flies off.
units.italian: "Sei fortunato a essere ancora vivo, ma anche così non ci servi a nulla se pensi sia saggio usare un'arma da fuoco contro un'astronave. Addio." Si voltano e se ne vanno senza un'altra parola, e la nave decolla.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	You manage to land a shot, although it seems to do nothing to the large spacecraft before you. Then you hear a small explosion. You aren't sure whether the damaged ship's systems failed on their own, or if by some stroke of luck, your shot did something to it.|218|0
units.english: You manage to land a shot, although it seems to do nothing to the large spacecraft before you. Then you hear a small explosion. You aren't sure whether the damaged ship's systems failed on their own, or if by some stroke of luck, your shot did something to it.
units.italian: Riesci a mettere a segno un colpo, anche se sembra non fare nulla alla grande navicella davanti a te. Poi senti una piccola esplosione. Non sei sicuro se i sistemi della nave danneggiata siano ceduti da soli, o se per un colpo di fortuna il tuo sparo abbia fatto qualcosa.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	Unfortunately, you do not get a chance to ponder your actions, as the ship abruptly explodes, taking you and everyone else on the beach down with it.|219|0
units.english: Unfortunately, you do not get a chance to ponder your actions, as the ship abruptly explodes, taking you and everyone else on the beach down with it.
units.italian: Purtroppo non hai il tempo di riflettere sulle tue azioni, perché la nave esplode di colpo, portandoti con sé e con tutti gli altri sulla spiaggia.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|	You miss your shot. Neither the ship nor the two Hai react. You feel like you heard a chuckle, but you're not sure where it came from.|222|0
units.english: You miss your shot. Neither the ship nor the two Hai react. You feel like you heard a chuckle, but you're not sure where it came from.
units.italian: Mancchi il colpo. Né la nave né i due Hai reagiscono. Ti sembra di aver sentito una risatina, ma non sei sicuro da dove venga.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 1|log|229|0
units.english: Accepted a somewhat shady deal for an old Hai ship called an Anomalocaris; the transaction could not be conducted through normal channels, so a loan was issued in lieu of a conventional purchase. It seems to still be in a good enough state to fly.
units.italian: Accettato un accordo alquanto losco per una vecchia nave Hai chiamata Anomalocaris; la transazione non poteva passare per i canali normali, così è stato emesso un prestito al posto di un acquisto convenzionale. Sembra essere ancora in uno stato sufficientemente buono per volare.
